review_locator: PMCID:PMC8013977, Transcription Factors Associated With IL-15 Cytokine Signaling During NK Cell Development; PMCID:PMC5059362, Type 1 Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology
primary_title: Innate immunodeficiency following genetic ablation of Mcl1 in natural killer cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-15 dose-dependent Mcl1 regulation in NK cells, with STAT5 binding at the Mcl1 3-prime untranslated region and NK-cell survival dependent on Mcl1.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15-associated MCL1 gene-expression/survival bridge; retain the NK-cell and STAT5 context and do not infer a terminal-TF claim.

primary_title: Critical functions for STAT5 tetramers in the maturation and survival of natural killer cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-15-treated NK cells have STAT5 binding at Bcl2 regulatory regions, reduced Bcl2 expression when STAT5 tetramers are disrupted, and corresponding loss of NK-cell survival.
limitations_preserved: Promote as a bounded IL-15-associated BCL2 gene-expression/survival bridge; retain STAT5 tetramer and NK-cell context without extending to other cytokines or terminal-TF inference.
